heading: Houston cost comparison: what changes the price
body: In Houston, a common working comparison range for the exam portion alone is about $200-$500, but the total can move higher when vaccines, TB testing, bloodwork, or return visits are added.
That range is useful only as a comparison starting point. The real decision is whether the quote covers the exam only or the full process through paperwork and follow-up.
A strong Houston city page should help readers compare scope, not just compare the cheapest number.
bullets: Ask whether the quoted price is exam-only or full-process
Ask whether vaccines are billed separately
Ask whether lab work is billed separately
Ask whether return visits or corrections cost extra
Ask the clinic to confirm USCIS civil-surgeon designation
